resources.string: When the match\'s channel goes to its adverts (before kick-off, at half time, after the game: its logo goes), Homefield\'s own break takes over: what\'s on your TV to carry on, new episodes, your list and reminders, the other games, the headlines and a trailer, with the channel in a small window. Back to the channel when the adverts end.

The scoreboard, the mark over the channel\'s logo and the scoreboard over other apps move a pixel or two every minute, and dim a little after five minutes without a change, so they never burn into the screen.
